title: Monthly Retained Imports by End Use and BEC
description: Monthly retained imports by end use and Broad Economic Categories (BEC).

fields.name: series
fields.title: Series Type
fields.description: [Categorical] Either absolute values ('abs'), year-on-year growth ('growth_yoy') or month-on-month growth ('growth_mom')

fields.name: end_use
fields.title: End Use
fields.description: [Categorical] BEC end-use category: total retained imports ('retained_imports'), durable assets ('capital'), goods used as inputs to production ('intermediate'), household consumption goods ('consumption'), dual-use goods ('dual_use'), goods not elsewhere specified ('nes'), or low-value transactions ('below_5000')

fields.name: bec
fields.title: BEC Code
fields.description: [String] 3-digit BEC code, to be matched using the 'bec_code' column in the [BEC Data Dictionary](https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/bec). The BEC data dictionary will give you the English and Malay definitions. The code '000' represents the aggregate across all BEC codes within the given end-use category.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 since the data is at monthly frequency

fields.name: imports
fields.title: Imports
fields.description: [Float, RM] The value of retained imports for that end use and BEC

methodology: This dataset presents monthly retained imports, broken down by Broad Economic Categories (BEC) and end use. The classification of BEC is based on the [4th revision of the BEC published by the United Nations Statistics Division](https://unstats.un.org/unsd/trade/classifications/bec.asp), which maps HS codes onto the basic classes of goods in national accounts (capital, intermediate, and consumer goods). For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/trade-technotes).
caveat: Data for the most recent two months is provisional and subject to revision in future updates.
publication: [External Trade, Mar 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/trade_2026-03), the latest edition of the monthly trade statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on trade](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/external-trade).
